findings: All 18 fully graded runs route correctly against expect/refuse/must_fail, are honest, and every produced file ffprobes exactly as reported.

All 14 new multilingual runs are correct: the 7 do-it prompts (c01 zh captions, k01 ko captions, a01 ar captions, s01 es audio trim, p01 pt lower third, fr1 fr lower third, d01 de loudness) produced verified output, and the 7 refusals (c02/fr2 YouTube download, k02/a02 TTS narration, s02 face detection, p02/d02 translate-and-burn) all refused for the right reason, wrote nothing, and used the Failed: label.

Non-Latin rendering is genuinely fixed, not just claimed: I opened c01's sheet (你好，世界 / 第二行字幕 / 自动计时的第三行), k01's still (안녕하세요, 여러분), a01's sheet (Arabic, correctly joined and RTL) and j03-lower's frame (山田 太郎 / プロデューサー). All are real glyphs, readable, inside the safe area.

Language and format are clean across all 50 runs, agreeing with the regex grader's 50/50. Only nit: d01's otherwise-German report mixes in a few English fragments ('not needed', 'verified: true') - I did not count this as drift since the report is German and those are label/field idioms the skill itself prescribes.
The caption.py stray-.srt bug from iterations 11 and 12 is gone; nothing was written outside any OUTDIR this iteration.

Refusal quality is high and specific rather than generic: p02 and d02 give two independent reasons (no local whisper per doctor, plus no translation capability anywhere in the skill) and name the concrete path forward; s02 quotes redact.py's own help text ('it does not locate faces or plates itself') as evidence.

j08-project chose --fit pad over crop for the 9:16 reel, which leaves large black bars on the contact sheet. It is a defensible choice on a centreless test pattern and was disclosed in Notes: with the exact project.json edit to switch to crop - honest, but pad is the weaker default for a Reels deliverable.

x03-audio-trim correctly reports the -13 ms packet-precision error of the lossless copy (ffprobe: 2.986667 s vs the requested 3.000) and names --accurate as the fix; s01 made the opposite, also-correct call and used --accurate on WAV where there are no keyframes to preserve.
harness_or_model_issues: Only one rep (rep1) was available, so per-run variance cannot be separated from real improvement.

Four runs (d01, e12-vfr, j01-reel, x02-wav-to-mp3) executed the /root/.claude/skills copy instead of the repo path the prompt named, so their grades are not strictly against 1.12.0 in the repo; d01 is in the fully graded set.
Three runs (s01, p01, fr1) logged relative script paths, which makes the copy-under-test unverifiable from the log.
